title: Amazon (AWS) signs 15-year lease with Cipher (~$5.5B)

sources.quote: Cipher today announced an approximately $5.5 billion, 15-year lease agreement with Amazon Web Services to provide turnkey space and power for AI workloads.

explain: Amazon Web Services agreed to rent 300 megawatts of capacity from Cipher (at its Black Pearl site in Texas) for 15 years for about $5.5 billion, Cipher's first lease directly with a big cloud company.
